svg.text: Mockup showing every operating category with every status/risk tone. Category = icon/left accent. Status/risk = event background and status chip.
WEEK VIEW WITH MIXED CATEGORY + RISK EVENTS
This is the kind of density the calendar may reach once crew, freight, equipment, relocation, and nursery items all land on the same schedule.
Category colors show type. Status colors show condition.
Every cell uses the status/risk background and the category accent. This is the collision test.
